source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 114, fielded September 13-18, 2022.
method: Population is respondent's self-reported religious affiliation (F_RELIG) - Wave 114 does not carry the finer F_RELTRAD frame variable used in other ATP waves in this dataset family. Share saying it is "essential" to what being a faithful member of their tradition means to them that they have "a personal relationship with Jesus Christ" (ESSENT_k_W114). This item was piped only to respondents whose tradition centers on Jesus Christ; Jewish, Muslim, Buddhist, Hindu, Other, and unaffiliated respondents show zero valid responses and are excluded. Refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W114 variable.
